people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?
translations.bsb: For who were the ones who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?
translations.kjv: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
translations.asv: For who, when they heard, did provoke? nay, did not all they that came out of Egypt by Moses?
